baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَقَالُوا لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ ... لَنَا
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers turn assent into a negotiated exchange: they reserve trust until the addressee performs a beneficiary-specific deliverable.

activation_trace.role: The branch image of negotiation makes their utterance function as terms proposed in a bargain.
Heart-settling assent is explicitly withheld as the consideration to be exchanged.

changed_reading.before: They simply announce that they do not yet believe.
changed_reading.after: They frame belief as payment conditional on satisfying terms they control.

baseline_models.mechanism: A wide breach is to open the lower ground so a hidden source becomes sustained visible outflow; the demanded sign is engineered disclosure rather than a momentary anomaly.

activation_trace.role: Wide splitting and emission supplies the breach that releases the demanded water.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the material layer to be opened.
Water emerging from an eye or the earth supplies the continuing visible source.

changed_reading.before: They ask for a miraculous spring.
changed_reading.after: They demand that concealed provision be forced through the earth into an inspectable, continuing source.

baseline_models.mechanism: The requested proof must not only certify a claim but also become a usable resource for the speakers; credibility is tied to material security delivered for us.

activation_trace.role: Security and trust make belief carry an affective demand for settled safety.
A real water source gives the requested security a durable material form.

changed_reading.before: The spring serves only as evidence for a proposition.
changed_reading.after: The sign must also secure the speakers materially, making trust depend on a resource delivered for their benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The root used for forced water-bursting also names dawn, whose recitation is witnessed. The demand shifts verification from a recurrent opening in time and recitation to a customized rupture in matter.

activation_trace.role: The focus uses wide splitting and emission as the requested hydraulic performance.
Dawn supplies a recurrent opening out of night rather than a requester-engineered rupture.
Presence with observation supplies the context's explicit mode of witnessing.

structural_cues: 17:78 repeats ف ج ر around the recitation and predicates witnessed presence of it, while 17:90 uses حَتَّىٰ to impose a different evidentiary threshold.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared ف ج ر root and explicit witnessing; I infer a contrast between given recurrent disclosure and commissioned spectacle. A live alternative is that dawn and water are merely separate senses with no polemical contrast.

changed_reading.before: The requested rupture is simply the speakers' chosen miracle.
changed_reading.after: It is a substituted proof regime: a controllable material bursting is demanded in place of an already witnessed, recurrent disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: What is delivered from the recitation has divergent effects according to its recipient. Belief therefore cannot be modeled as the automatic result of adding a sufficiently vivid neutral stimulus.

activation_trace.role: The focus withholds assent until an imposed condition is met.
Delivery and conveyance supply a sign already reaching its recipients.
Settled affirmation identifies the receptive group for whom that delivery becomes healing and mercy.

structural_cues: 17:82 assigns healing and mercy to believers but increase of loss to wrongdoers from the same recited delivery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one delivered recitation and recipient-dependent outcomes; I infer that reception conditions the evidentiary effect. A live alternative is that the spring request is a sincere test whose result has not yet been seen.

changed_reading.before: A custom sign should produce the withheld belief once delivered.
changed_reading.after: No custom production guarantees assent because the recipient's stance already helps determine what the sign becomes for that recipient.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the spring demand, exempla have already been turned through many forms, yet refusal remains. The new condition reads as replacement of an evidentiary criterion rather than identification of the first missing proof.

activation_trace.role: Withheld assent names what the new condition claims it would release.
Turning from state to state supplies prior variation in how the case has been presented.
Refusal and abstention supply the response that persists after variation.
Blocking the truth characterizes the residue of that persistent refusal.

structural_cues: 17:89's varied exempla and surviving refusal are immediately followed by 17:90's لَن ... حَتَّىٰ demand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, varied exempla, and persisting refusal; I infer that the spring is a replacement criterion in a moving test. A live alternative is that it specifies a genuinely unmet category of evidence.

changed_reading.before: The speakers offer one stable condition for belief.
changed_reading.after: They replace already varied evidence with a newly controlled criterion, so the condition functions as refusal-management.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the spring, the requests expand through garden rivers, a falling sky, divine and angelic presence, ascent, and a descended readable book. Even ascent is followed by another until-clause, exposing the threshold as recursively movable.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies the first requested breach and emission in the escalating series.
The focus makes assent the stated endpoint of the first condition.
Repeated wide emission enlarges one spring into rivers driven through a garden.
Downward falling changes controlled water release into cosmic collapse.
Ascent on a height supplies the upward counter-motion in the demand sequence.
Assent is withheld again even after the proposed ascent.
Delivery downward adds another required act after ascent.
Reading and recitation make the newly delivered object subject to the requesters' inspection.

structural_cues: The repeated أَوْ chain in 17:91-93 broadens the demands, and 17:93 repeats وَلَن نُّؤْمِنَ ... حَتَّىٰ after the proposed ascent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an escalating sequence and a repeated conditional refusal; I infer that satisfying one spectacle generates another condition. A live alternative is that the verses list cumulative desiderata rather than deliberately moving goalposts.

changed_reading.before: The spring is a finite threshold that would close the dispute.
changed_reading.after: The spring is the opening bid in a recursive demand structure whose next threshold appears as soon as the previous one is imagined satisfied.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speakers demand that terrestrial matter perform an extraordinary certification, while the following diagnosis says human embodiment blocks belief and explains that the messenger medium matches earth's inhabitants. Their test accepts earth as a stage but rejects an earth-proportioned bearer of guidance.

activation_trace.role: The lower realm opposite the sky is the demanded site of certification.
The focus makes assent depend on what that terrestrial site produces.
A barrier between a person and what is sought supplies the context's diagnosis of blocked belief.
Assent is the action explicitly blocked when guidance arrives.
The visibly embodied human supplies the feature treated as disqualifying.
Messenger and message identify the rejected bearer-function.
Earth again supplies the inhabited lower domain to which a messenger must be proportioned.
Walking movement marks the ordinary embodied mode of the hypothetical inhabitants.
Settled repose makes that mode of earthly habitation stable rather than incidental.
The messenger branch supplies the medium matched to the nature of its recipients.

structural_cues: 17:94 asks whether God sent a human messenger; 17:95 answers with the counterfactual of angels walking settled on earth receiving an angelic messenger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated earth, the human objection, and the inhabitant-messenger counterfactual; I infer a medium-mismatch behind the requested sign. A live alternative is that the demands challenge authority without rejecting embodiment itself.

changed_reading.before: They ask earth to yield a sufficiently supernatural proof.
changed_reading.after: They require supernatural behavior from earth while refusing the human messenger fitted to earthly recipients, making the demanded medium itself part of the blockage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ف ج ر B005 is a generosity branch rather than the immediate hydraulic sense. It remains anchored in the focus verb, لَنَا, and the nearby bounty and garden-river sequence; downstream prose should present it as branch-play that supplements, not replaces, the water sense.

activation_trace.role: Wide bursting generosity lets the requested act be heard as compelled largesse for the speakers.
Benefaction and gift supply a nearby model of bounty that is given rather than commissioned.
The river demand expands the imagined largesse from one source into an entire productive estate.

changed_reading.before: The spectacle is requested only to certify the messenger.
changed_reading.after: The demand also tries to conscript prophetic agency into producing distributable bounty for the requester group.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ن ب ع B004 transfers a speech image onto the noun for a water source. It remains focus-only and anchored by the opening قَالُوا and closing يَنۢبُوعًا; downstream prose should mark it as a verbal-material echo, not the noun's primary contextual sense.

activation_trace.role: Audible utterance supplies the speakers' emergence into voiced demand.
Bursting into speech after silence mirrors the requested emergence of a spring.

changed_reading.before: Their utterance merely names the spring they want.
changed_reading.after: Their own voiced demand becomes a speech-spring, verbally enacting the emergence they require from the earth.

strongest_changes: The spring condition becomes a negotiated and recursively movable proof regime rather than a finite test.
The witnessed dawn and recipient-dependent recitation expose disclosure and reception already operating outside requester control.
The earth demand is sharpened by the later rejection of a human messenger proportioned to earthly recipients.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly reuses focus roots across different media: ف ج ر joins dawn to water, ء م ن tracks changing reception and repeated refusal, and ء ر ض joins the demanded site to the messenger-recipient fit.
remaining_uncertainties: The dawn-water contrast may be deliberate activation or only polysemy within the shared root.
The escalation can indicate moving goalposts, but it can also be read as a cumulative catalog of desired signs.
The generosity and speech-spring readings are branch-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
